title: The Feast of Mending
text: The Commons has called a feast to mend the quarrels between the Great Houses: one long table in the square, with every House's lord seated at it and every House's cooks feeding it. The old women say a feast like this once ended a war. They also say one started a war.

options.label: Send your best food and your best manners to help mend what is broken.

outcomes.text: Your dishes are praised and your toasts drunk. For one evening, nobody at the table reaches for a knife.

options.label: Name a rival House and see to its cup; feasts have ended wars before, and started them.

outcomes.text: Nobody dies, and nobody can prove anything. Still, one House's Scion is carried home green and shaking, and your House's name is whispered with a new respect.

options.label: Plead illness and stay at home; let the others mend what they broke.

outcomes.text: Your empty chair is noticed, and remembered.

together.text: Every House brings its best. Old quarrels are toasted away at a feast that runs till dawn, and all night the Rift is quiet.
Nobody brings food. The long table stands empty in the square all night. In the morning the poor say the dead sat down at it.
